suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require workers who claim failure-first testing to record the exact failing targeted validator or browser signal observed before the patch, or explicitly note when they are relying on previously captured failure evidence instead.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The current rerun fixed the blocking `/account` route-level Suspense coverage issue, but `worker-transcripts.jsonl:91` shows the patch was applied before the first targeted `bun test ./apps/web/tests/account-shell-hydration.test.tsx` run while the handoff still marked `skillFeedback.followedProcedure: true`. That suggests the skill/handoff rubric should require concrete failure-first evidence instead of relying on self-reporting alone.
